generator_scripts.padbit.py:
"""Rewrite volatile pad-word bit tests of one TU block as PAD_BIT(word, n).
usage: padbit.py SRC_TU BLOCK [--dry]   (run from the worktree root)
Strips `*(volatile u16 *)&PAD` / `*(u16 volatile *)&(PAD)` views (with their 'Retail reloads'
comments) over the pad words lbl_1_bss_9F8 / lbl_1_bss_D58, then turns every `((PAD >> n) & 1)`
and `(PAD & 1)` test of a pad word into PAD_BIT. Prints the block's remaining volatile tokens."""
import re
import sys
from pathlib import Path

path, name = Path(sys.argv[1]), sys.argv[2]
t = path.read_text()
m = re.search(r"^/\* fzgx:begin %s(?: [^*]*)? \*/\n" % re.escape(name), t, re.M)
b0 = m.start()
b1 = t.index(f"/* fzgx:end {name} */", b0)
blk = t[b0:b1]

PADW = r"(?:\(&lbl_1_bss_(?:9F8|D58)\.unk_\w+\)\[10\]|lbl_1_bss_(?:9F8|D58)(?:\[\d\])?\.(?:unk_\w+|down|button|held|c))"
CMT = r"(?:\s*/\* Retail reloads this field\. \*/)?"
VOLT = r"(?:volatile u16|u16 volatile)"
# views: (*(volatile u16 *)&(PAD)) CMT  |  *(volatile u16 *)&PAD CMT  |  *((volatile u16 *)&PAD)
a = blk
a = re.sub(r"\(\*\(%s \*\)&\(?(%s)\)?\)%s" % (VOLT, PADW, CMT), r"(\1)", a)
a = re.sub(r"\*\(\(%s \*\)&(%s)\)" % (VOLT, PADW), r"\1", a)
a = re.sub(r"\*\(%s \*\)&\(?(%s)\)?%s" % (VOLT, PADW, CMT), r"\1", a)
# bit tests: replace exactly "(X >> n) & 1" (one open paren) or "X & 1"; the enclosing
# parenthesis stays, so the expression remains balanced
X = r"(\(%s\)|%s)" % (PADW, PADW)
def arg(x):
    return x[1:-1] if x.startswith("(") and x.endswith(")") and x.count("(") == x.count(")") and not x.startswith("(&") else x
a = re.sub(r"\((?:\(u16\) )?%s >> (\d+)U?\) & (?:0x)?1(?![\dxXuU])" % X, lambda m: "PAD_BIT(%s, %s)" % (arg(m.group(1)), m.group(2)), a)
a = re.sub(r"(?<![\w.>)\]])%s & (?:0x)?1(?![\dxXuU])" % X, lambda m: "PAD_BIT(%s, 0)" % arg(m.group(1)), a)
PB = r"PAD_BIT\((?:[^()]|\((?:[^()]|\([^()]*\))*\))*\)"
while True:
    b = re.sub(r"(?<![\w\])])(?<!if )(?<!while )(?<!return )\((%s)\)" % PB, r"\1", a)
    if b == a: break
    a = b
def balanced(s):
    d = 0
    for ch in s:
        d += ch == "("; d -= ch == ")"
        if d < 0: return False
    return d == 0
for la, lb in zip(blk.splitlines(), a.splitlines()):
    assert la.count("(") - la.count(")") == lb.count("(") - lb.count(")"), lb
if a == blk:
    print("no change"); sys.exit(1)
left = [l.strip()[:160] for l in a.splitlines() if "volatile" in l and "fzgxpool" not in l and "primer" not in l]
raw = re.findall(r"%s\)* (?:>> \d+U?\) & 1|& 1\))" % PADW, a)
print(f"{name}: PAD_BIT {a.count('PAD_BIT')}, raw tests left {len(raw)}, volatile lines left {len(left)}")
for l in left:
    print("   ", l)
if "--dry" not in sys.argv:
    t = t[:b0] + a + t[b1:]
    if '#include "game/pad.h"' not in t:
        i = t.index("\n", t.index("#include ")) + 1
        t = t[:i] + '#include "game/pad.h"\n' + t[i:]
    path.write_text(t)

"""Record collapsed-unit device-inverse probes through the shared repair engine and archive them.
usage: engine_archive.py SCRATCH OUTDIR [--smoke]   (run from the worktree root)
Every body is a whole collapsed unit (the verified generated unit with one edit), recorded
against the owner function's retail object with the unit's actual compiler profile."""
import sys, json, re, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, 'tools')
from fzgx import fixup, oracle
from fzgx.project import Project

S = Path(sys.argv[1]); out = Path(sys.argv[2]); smoke = '--smoke' in sys.argv
MAIN = Path('/home/armandofm/projects/fzgx')
p = Project('GFZE01'); e = fixup.Engine(p, out); rows = []
units = {u['source']: u for u in json.load(open(MAIN / 'config/GFZE01/units.json'))}


def base_text(unit_src):
    g = MAIN / 'build/GFZE01/gen' / unit_src
    return (g if g.exists() else MAIN / 'src' / unit_src).read_text()


def profile(unit_src):
    """mw and unit extra flags exactly as configured for the collapsed unit."""
    u = units[unit_src]
    s = p.resolve(u['module'] + ':' + u['symbols'][0]) if u['symbols'][0] in ('_prolog', '_epilog') else p.resolve(u['symbols'][0])
    mw, flags = oracle.version_for(p, s)
    return mw, flags


controls = {}


def control(owner, unit_src):
    if owner not in controls:
        mw, flags = profile(unit_src)
        controls[owner] = e.record(owner, base_text(unit_src), mw, flags, label='installed collapsed-unit control',
                                   unit=unit_src)
        rows.append(controls[owner])
    return controls[owner]


def add(owner, unit_src, path, label):
    base = control(owner, unit_src)
    text = Path(path).read_text()
    assert text != base_text(unit_src), (owner, label)
    row = e.record(owner, text, base['mw'], base['flags'], parent=base['id'], label=label, unit=unit_src)
    rows.append(row)
    return row

    ('sel:fn_10_18A50', 'rel/sel/sel/fn_10_18A50.c', [S / 'a50' / (k + '.c') for k in ('off', 'typ', 'off_id', 'typ_id')], 'PAD_BIT polls, id read: '),
    ('sel:fn_10_578C', 'rel/sel/sel/fn_10_0.c', [S / 's578/A.c', S / 's578/B.c'], 'PAD_BIT over the same address forms: '),
    ('main_rel:fn_1_ABAC', 'rel/main_rel/camera/fn_1_ABAC.c', [S / 'abac/helper.c', S / 'abac/direct.c'], 'pad direction tests as PAD_BIT: '),
    ('main_rel:fn_1_12B664', 'rel/main_rel/archive/fn_1_12B664.c', [S / 'arc/typ.c', S / 'arc/typ_plain.c'], 'typed pad fields for the buttons pointer: '),
]
todo = []
for owner, unit_src, files, label in manual:
    for f in files:
        todo.append((owner, unit_src, f, label + f.stem))
if smoke:
    keep = {('car_colchg:colchg_chgcol_disp', 'carid_first_x1'), ('car_colchg:colchg_selmate_disp', 'plain')}
    todo = [t for t in todo if (t[0], t[2].stem) in keep]
for t in todo:

# the accepted, installed forms (worktree's regenerated units) for every changed owner
INSTALLED = {
    'sel:fn_10_A90C': 'rel/sel/sel/fn_10_0.c', 'sel:fn_10_578C': 'rel/sel/sel/fn_10_0.c',

if not smoke:

              stopping_condition='One pass over the 54 new census spots in 6 collapsed units (single removals, per-token volatile '
